route_title: Extended Cr Bound with Diversity Injection
compilation_rationale: Compiled bounded thickness optimization for a fixed 20-layer Cr/HfO2/SiO2 stack on Al. Explicit initial thicknesses applied with broad per-layer bounds. Gradient-based optimizer searches thicknesses only. Targets enforce broadband absorption and reflection bands while suppressing cross-band responses. Uncertainty policy tracks manufacturing tolerances.
